paragraphs.text:
Either Bernard’s abductors have concealed their trail, or Charlie 
is deliberately failing to track them. You ought to continue, but 
the Big Woods feel vast and overwhelming.

To leave the valley in defeat, go to 32. To continue the search, go 
to 52.
